# فلمك — Filmak

> Filmak is an AI-powered movie and TV recommendations service in Arabic and English, using TMDB data with intelligent suggestions across Gemini, GPT, Groq, Mistral and OpenRouter models.

Filmak helps viewers discover films and series by mood, genre, cast, or free-form prompt. Users can browse trending, top-rated, popular, now-playing, and upcoming titles, save favorites, and get personalized AI recommendations.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Landing page with search, AI recommendations, and curated movie & TV lists.
- [Discover](/discover): Advanced filtering by genre, year, rating, and language.
- [Movie details](/movie/278): Example movie page with cast, trailer, ratings, and similar titles.
- [TV details](/tv/1399): Example series page with seasons, cast, and details.
- [Person](/person/500): Actor / director filmography and biography.
- [Genre](/genre/28): Browse all titles in a specific genre.
- [Sign in](/auth): Create an account to save favorites and personalized lists.

## Optional

- [Sitemap](/sitemap.xml): Machine-readable index of all public pages.
- [Robots](/robots.txt): Crawler rules.
